evidence: The nickel precursor was kept in a glass bubbler in an oven, and was heated to 70 °C to afford saturated vapor pressure of ~140 mTorr. The nickel precursor was delivered into the deposition chamber with the assist of purified N 2 carrier gas (through a Gatekeeper inert gas purifier). As for the H2S gas (3% diluted in N 2), it was first delivered into a ~5 mL gas trap and then delivered into the deposition chamber for depositing films. The deposition temperature was varied from 90 to 300 °C.
